# Vendored upstream Neurodesktop files

Everything under this directory (except this README and the MANIFEST) is a
byte-for-byte copy of files from https://github.com/neurodesk/neurodesktop
at the commit pinned in `../../UPSTREAM_REF`.

**Do not edit these files by hand.** They are (re)generated by
`scripts/neurodesk-vendor-upstream.sh` from the paths listed in `MANIFEST`,
and this directory is excluded from pre-commit formatting hooks so the
copies stay identical to upstream.

If a file needs a local (Nectar VDS) modification, move it out of the
MANIFEST into `../config/` and change the task that installs it; see the
role README for the sync workflow.
